items: After the win, a 🪩 pointer leads you to the dancefloor; reach it and the night settles, the pins guiding you home at once
The spell's music notes appear only as you get close to the stone
Leash chains look joined whichever way they run
The spell's ring shows all the way round the stone
Sigils are red for the wild and blue for your friends, muted to vivid by rank; every baby's is purple
Legends' sigils are bigger, the most vivid colour of their side, with a glint sweeping across them
